item.title: Zelda demake keeps flopping
item.description:
>Barely sold 250k copies in France (Nintendo’s strongest EU market)
>Sold 100k copies in UK (Second’s biggest Nintendo market)
>Sold 800 copies in Spain
>It’s reported that stock is completely full in Japan, no one is buying it
>US is already putting it in the clearance bins for $5
What went so fucking wrong?
